lab.title: Wazuh OVA Monitoring Lab
lab.courseNote: System monitoring and security management — Wazuh v4.14.7 OVA manager with endpoint agents for the Windows lab host and VPN server.

architecture.label: Wazuh OVA VM
architecture.detail: VirtualBox OVA v4.14.7 at 10.225.42.4 — wazuh-manager and wazuh-dashboard services active

architecture.label: WinVM
architecture.detail: Microsoft Windows 11 Enterprise Evaluation agent ID 001 at 10.225.42.3

architecture.label: vpn-server
architecture.detail: Ubuntu VPN host agent ID 002 at 10.225.42.1 reporting to the OVA manager

steps.title: Setup and installation
steps.summary: Deployed Wazuh using the official VirtualBox OVA instead of Docker. Manager and dashboard services are enabled and running on the lab VM.
actions: Imported the Wazuh v4.14.7 OVA into Oracle VirtualBox
Confirmed wazuh-dashboard.service is active (running) and enabled on boot
Confirmed wazuh-manager.service is active (running) via wazuh-control start
Opened the Wazuh dashboard Endpoints view and Deploy new agent workflow

evidence.title: OVA manager + dashboard running
evidence.caption: systemctl status showing wazuh-dashboard and wazuh-manager active on the Wazuh v4.14.7 OVA

evidence.title: Deploy new agent UI
evidence.caption: Wazuh dashboard Deploy new agent page for packaging, server address, and agent name

steps.title: Configuration for monitoring
steps.summary: Enrolled endpoint agents against manager 10.225.42.4. The VPN host was installed from the 4.14.7 DEB package as vpn-server; WinVM appears as an active Windows agent in the dashboard.
actions: Installed wazuh-agent 4.14.7 on the VPN host with WAZUH_MANAGER=10.225.42.4 and WAZUH_AGENT_NAME=vpn-server
Enabled and started wazuh-agent with systemctl on the VPN host
Registered/connected the Windows lab endpoint as agent WinVM (10.225.42.3)
Verified Endpoints view shows both agents active under the default group

evidence.title: VPN server agent install
evidence.caption: curl + dpkg install of wazuh-agent_4.14.7 with manager 10.225.42.4 and name vpn-server, then systemctl enable/start

evidence.title: Active agents in Endpoints
evidence.caption: Endpoints summary with 2 active agents: WinVM (Windows 11) and vpn-server (Ubuntu 26.04)

verification.title: Agents reporting to the manager
verification.summary: The OVA manager is healthy and two agents are active. Assignment asks for three monitored components (hosting laptop, VM, VPN). Current evidence covers the OVA VM plus WinVM and vpn-server; add a third agent if the hosting laptop is still separate from WinVM.
checks: Wazuh OVA imported and powered on in VirtualBox
Optional remaining item: dedicated hosting-laptop agent if WinVM is not that host
